items.english: The more often something needs you, the closer it lives. That can save walking and work over a season.
items.draft: Hoe meer gereeld iets jou nodig het, hoe nader woon dit. Dit kan oor 'n seisoen loop en werk spaar.
items.backtranslation: The more often something needs you, the closer it lives. It can run/last over a season and save work.
items.problem: "Dit kan oor 'n seisoen loop en werk spaar" reads most naturally as "it can last over a season and save work" (loop = run/last), so the saving in walking is lost and the sentence is unclear.
items.corrected: Hoe meer gereeld iets jou nodig het, hoe nader woon dit. Oor 'n seisoen kan dit jou geloop en werk spaar.
